Hi Marissa / Nikhil,

Thanks for the demo today — the platform looks promising. A few security and privacy items our compliance team asked me to confirm so we can move forward with our procurement checklist:

- SOC 2: Do you have SOC 2 Type II coverage? If yes, could you share a redacted report or summary?
- HIPAA: Do you support HIPAA / BAA for regulated workloads?
- GDPR: Any EU data processing addenda or standard contractual clauses?
- Telemetry & Cookies: We need a short note on what product telemetry you collect from the console and docs site, whether it contains PII, and retention windows.
- Vendor questionnaire: We will send our security questionnaire — can you assign someone to complete it?

Can you also propose next steps / timeline for us? Our security lead is Procurement@acmehealth.com.

Thanks,
Alicia Torres
Director of IT Security
Acme Health

Message 2/5
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 + telemetry questions

Hi Alicia,

Great to meet you yesterday — appreciate the clear list. Summary answers below, and I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary we can share with reviewers. We can also provide a fully redacted report under NDA if needed.

SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2025; we perform annual audits. Attached: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf. Full report available under NDA.

HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA. We offer a BAA for customers with regulated PHI workloads.

GDPR / Data Processing: We provide a Data Processing Addendum and support SCCs for EU customers.

Telemetry & Cookies (high level):
- Console telemetry: non-PII usage metrics, performance traces, error logs. We collect request metadata (model, route, timestamp), token usage, and anonymized latencies.
- Docs site: standard web analytics and cookie-based tracking (page views, session duration).
- PII: We do not intentionally collect or index customer PII in telemetry. Error reports may include redacted input snippets; customers can opt-in or opt-out of detailed telemetry.
- Retention: Default telemetry retention is 90 days for aggregated metrics; logs for troubleshooting are retained 30 days by default and can be extended under contract for enterprise customers.

Vendor questionnaire: Please send the questionnaire. I assigned our security engineer to own the response (Lauren on cc).

Next steps I propose:
1) We deliver the SOC 2 summary now and confirm availability of the full report under NDA.
2) Please send your vendor questionnaire; Lauren will coordinate completions and aim to return within 5 business days.
3) If needed, we schedule a 30-min call with your security lead to walk through any items.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts

Thanks for the quick response and the SOC 2 summary — that helps. A couple of follow-ups on telemetry so we can sign this off with our privacy officer:

1) Console telemetry: When you say request metadata and anonymized latencies, can you confirm whether request inputs (prompts) or outputs are ever logged in full to production telemetry? If yes, what fields are redacted and how long are those retained?
2) Error reports: You mentioned redacted input snippets. Is that automated redaction or manual? Can customers configure that behavior per-org?
3) Docs site cookies: Which third-party analytics providers do you use (Google Analytics, Plausible, etc.) and do you have a current cookie policy to share?
4) HIPAA BAA: Can you share a template or summary of the BAA terms and any limitations around model training or data use?

If you prefer, we can take the questionnaire route. I'll attach it to this thread by end of day.

Best,
Alicia

Message 4/5
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 + telemetry questions

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the great questions. Answers below, and we can attach the questionnaire if you prefer that route. I've also attached our vendor questionnaire template to help speed things up.

1) Request inputs/outputs: Production telemetry does not store full customer prompts or model outputs by default. We store request metadata (model id, route, token counts, timing). For debugging, we do have an optional detailed trace that can include redacted input snippets.
   - Redaction: Automated redaction is applied to traces by default; we remove email addresses, credit card patterns, and other obvious PII. Redaction rules are documented and can be customized for enterprise customers under contract.
   - Retention: Detailed traces with redacted snippets are retained 30 days by default; aggregated metrics are retained 90 days. Extended retention is available as an add-on.

2) Error reports: These are automatically generated. By default they include redacted snippets; manual access to full content requires customer approval or an internal engineering review with strict access controls and audit logs. Customers may opt-out of detailed traces entirely.

3) Docs site cookies / third-party analytics: We use Google Analytics for the docs site and a lightweight in-house telemetry service for product usage. Cookie and privacy details are listed here: https://docs.redwood.ai/privacy and our cookie banner allows opt-out for non-essential cookies.

4) HIPAA / BAA: We provide a standard BAA that covers processing of PHI when customers enable regulated workloads. It prohibits using customer data for model training and includes standard obligations around access controls, encryption, breach notification, and subcontractor flow-down. I can share a redlined template under NDA.

Next steps:
- Please send the vendor questionnaire when ready.
- Lauren will own the questionnaire response; expect a 3-5 business day turnaround for the initial pass.
- If helpful, let's schedule a 30-minute call next week between your security lead and our security team. Nikhil, can you propose 2 x 30-min slots?

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_ACME.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
